result_text:
I changed `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so `all_files.zip` no longer uses fixed file names. I did not run any tests or try a rename. The only check was `mvn -q -o -pl reports compile`, which succeeded.

The export now takes the five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) from the analysis results, in that order. It builds each zip entry name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same helper that writes the loose `data/text/aspect_<name>.txt` files, so the lookup and the entry name always match.

With the default configuration the entries stay `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` and `aspect_other.txt`. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The failed read used to throw before `git-history.zip` was written, so that file is written again too, as long as a `git-history.txt` exists.

`LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 280–283) also hardcodes `aspect_main.txt` and `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. I left it alone because it is outside this export.
